senses.gloss: गोत्र lit. family. The word is used by Panini in the technical sense of a descendant except the son or a daughter; cf. अपत्यं पौत्रप्रभृति गोत्रम् P. IV. 1.162. The word गोत्रापत्य is also used in the same sense. The affix, which is found many times in the sense of gotra, barring the usual अण् , is यञ् ; cf. गर्गादिभ्यो यञ् P. IV. 1.105.
गोत्रप्रत्यय affix in the sense of गोत्र; cf. यश्चासौ गोत्रप्रत्ययः प्राप्नोति स एकः स्यात् M. Bh.on IV. 1.93.
गोत्रिन्द ( चक्रवर्तिन् ) writer of Samasa- vada, a short treatise on the sense conveyed by compound words.
